scope: Thirteen counterbalanced trials of 24 queries for each size and pinned state. Mode 0 reads the native attribute frame. Mode 1 uses the frame already present in the production descriptor. Mode 2 prepares a separate CGRect array once for the 24 calls. queryMS is mean wall milliseconds per query inside a trial. cpuMS is process CPU for the 24 calls plus any preparation. All three results contained identical native objects in the same order. UIKit ran in the stock iPad Simulator. These are fixed-work costs and do not establish visible frame time.
